title: pterigeron decurrens
intro: Pterigeron decurrens, commonly known as Pterigeron or Small-leaved Pterigeron, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, treating digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Pterigeron decurrens include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and diarrhea. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
